_about: The 125 establishments with "Reports to NADC" = Y in the WA Health Establishment List, May 2026 v0.1 (official code, name, Est type). HSP, region, district, beds and coordinates are NOT in that list: they are joined from SLIP / OpenStreetMap and labelled by hspBasis and locationStatus. See docs/ESTABLISHMENTS.md.
_attribution: © Government of Western Australia, Department of Health (Establishment List, May 2026; SLIP / data.wa.gov.au HEALTH-001, licence "Not specified"). OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) for the few coordinates marked osm-*.

establishments.name: Perth Children's Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Perth Children's Hospital is part of CAHS (DoH Central Referral Service page, 8 Sep 2026; SLIP lists it under the North Metro geographic service).

establishments.name: Oral Health Centre of WA
establishments.locationNote: OpenStreetMap: "Oral Health Centre of WA (OHCWA)", 17 Monash Avenue, Nedlands.
establishments.hspNote: Oral Health Centre of WA: HSP not stated anywhere in the supplied documents; shown under NMHS only because it is in Nedlands (display grouping).

establishments.name: Mount Lawley Hospital
establishments.slipName: St John of God Mt Lawley Hospital
establishments.locationNote: Plotted 60 m from 629 (same suburb, assumed same site).
establishments.hspNote: Official list has both 113 Mount Lawley Hospital and 629 St John of God Mt Lawley Hospital reporting to the NADC; assumed to be the same site (successor and predecessor code, not verified). Plotted next to 629.

establishments.name: Peel Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Peel Health Campus returned to public hands (SMHS) on 13 Aug 2024 (DoH CRS page). The official list has Peel under 145; SLIP uses 645.

establishments.name: Bethesda Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Private hospital. Shown under NMHS only because SLIP places it in the North Metro geographic service; why a private hospital reports to the NADC is not stated in the documents.
